property_summary: For any admissible target and value, sendMoney(target, v) transfers exactly v to _target, so C's balance decreases by exactly v; the mutant instead sends the funds to msg.sender, so the caller's balance (not the target's) increases and C's balance drops by 2*v, breaking the invariant for any target != caller.
change_summary: Replace _target with msg.sender so the funds are sent back to the caller instead of the target.
